name: Results jump (india-results-drift rule)
author: pack
hypothesis: A 4%+ move on quarterly results on 2x turnover, closing near the high, keeps drifting up (post-earnings drift) while NIFTY is above its 200-day average.
filter: days_since_result == 0 and result_ret >= {jump} and result_turn_mult >= {vol} and result_close_loc >= 0.75 and nifty_above_ma200 == 1
